subject: minecraft-1.8.8-trapped-chest-opening

observed_source_semantics.strong_power: getStrongPower is nonzero only for the UP side query and delegates to weak power
observed_source_semantics.open_transition: TileEntityChest.openInventory increments numPlayersUsing for non-spectators, emits chest block event id 1 with the new count, and notifies neighbors at the chest position and the block below
observed_source_semantics.close_transition: TileEntityChest.closeInventory decrements numPlayersUsing for non-spectators and emits the corresponding block event/neighbor notifications
observed_source_semantics.comparator_channel: BlockChest comparator input override uses Container.calcRedstoneFromInventory(getLockableContainer(...)); this is an inventory/fullness channel distinct from numPlayersUsing

runtime_hypothesis.fixture_channel: single real player opens a single trapped chest; adjacent redstone wire is the direct weak-power witness; that wire powers one command block with one scoped world-state target
runtime_hypothesis.control: same exact-version player remains on a neutral platform and never opens the chest
runtime_hypothesis.comparator_isolation: fixture contains no comparator and the trapped-chest inventory fingerprint must be identical across control and activated arms

inference_boundary: Opening-power evidence does not establish comparator inventory/fullness behavior.
Comparator inventory/fullness evidence must not be used as a substitute for player-open-count power.
A successful exact fixture may promote only the exact source/runtime relations it exercises; it does not license generic opaque-solid conduction.
Runtime execution is structural causal evidence, not player comprehension, fun, fairness, immersion, or overall quality.
